context.si_title: Solution Intent - Synthetic Order Routing Service

findings.title: Retry controls are undefined
findings.description: The design does not define the retry budget, backoff limits, or automatic-processing stop condition for ambiguous provider responses.
findings.recommended_change: Document a bounded retry budget, exponential-backoff limits, and the stop condition before another provider submission.

evidence.quote: The current design does not define the retry budget, exponential-backoff limits, or the point at which an unknown response must stop automatic processing. Without those controls, repeated submission after an ambiguous provider response could create duplicate fulfilment. Provider calls in the demonstration are represented only by deterministic local fixtures.
[09:12] Morgan Lee: The retry budget and exponential-backoff limits are not defined, so that is a high-severity finding.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

findings.title: Regional failover evidence is missing
findings.description: The warm standby design has neither a scheduled exercise nor a measured recovery result.
findings.recommended_change: Schedule the regional exercise and record measured recovery results against the draft targets.

evidence.quote: Regional recovery uses a warm standby design, but no failover exercise has been scheduled and no measured recovery result exists. The target recovery time is four hours and the target recovery point is fifteen minutes for synthetic routing records. These targets are scenario assumptions until a successful exercise provides evidence.
[09:16] Morgan Lee: The warm standby design has no scheduled regional failover exercise or measured recovery result.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

findings.title: Routing-record retention lacks approval
findings.description: The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period has not received formal governance confirmation.
findings.recommended_change: Obtain and record governance approval for the retention period before release readiness.

evidence.quote: The service intentionally excludes personal and payment information. Security logs contain synthetic order identifiers, policy versions, adapters, outcomes, and correlation identifiers. The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period requires governance confirmation before the design can be treated as release ready.
[09:24] Morgan Lee: Formal approval of the 30-day routing-record retention period is missing, so the privacy control remains open.
evidence.speaker: Morgan Lee

evidence.quote: [09:14] Riley Chen: I will document the retry budget, backoff limits, and stop condition by 18 September 2026.
evidence.speaker: Riley Chen
